stories.title: Revolut: dati sottratti a 680 clienti in Europa, hacker chiedono riscatto da 3 milioni di dollari

en.title: Revolut: data stolen from 680 customers in Europe, hackers demand 3 million dollar ransom
en.summary: Hackers stole personal data from approximately 680 Revolut customers across Europe and are demanding a 3 million dollar ransom. The attackers used an email address falsely linked to the Reggio Calabria Prefecture to make their data access requests appear legitimate.

stories.title: La chiamata alle urne di Putin: “Votate per la Duma e vinceremo”

en.title: Putin's call to vote: "Vote for the Duma and we will win"
en.summary: Parliamentary elections began in Russia, the first since the Ukraine invasion, with voting also occurring in annexed territories. Putin called on voters to demonstrate support for soldiers at the front, stating that no one can divide the country.

stories.title: Rabbino picchiato alla fermata del bus a Milano filma gli aggressori: tre giovani in questura

en.title: Rabbi beaten at bus stop in Milan films attackers: three young people in police station
en.summary: A rabbi was beaten at a bus stop in Milan by three young assailants who insulted him in Arabic and Italian, kicked him, and stole his hat. The victim filmed the attackers, who were taken to the police station.

stories.title: Hacker rivendicano violazione Revolut, 'abbiamo dati polizia italiana'

en.title: Hackers claim Revolut breach, 'we have Italian police data'
en.summary: Hackers claiming responsibility for a Revolut security breach told a news outlet they possess Italian police data. The hackers reportedly impersonated law enforcement agents for months during their operations.

stories.title: Hacker rivendicano violazione Revolut: "Abbiamo i dati della polizia italiana"

en.title: Hackers claim Revolut breach: "We have Italian police data"
en.summary: Hackers claiming responsibility for a Revolut breach state they obtained personal data from Italian police. The British online bank with 5 million Italian customers sent personal information of 680 clients after receiving a message from a Reggio Calabria prefect address.

stories.title: Via il bollo auto e moto sotto gli 80KW per il 2027. Accise, scende lo sconto dello Stato

en.title: Vehicle tax removed for cars and motorcycles under 80KW starting 2027. State discount on excise taxes reduced
en.summary: Italy's government decided to eliminate vehicle tax for cars and motorcycles under 80 kilowatts beginning in 2027 and reduce state excise tax discounts. The government views this as removing a heavily disliked tax, while opposition parties argue it is a temporary electoral measure rather than permanent policy.

stories.title: Bollo auto e moto: dalla Pandina alla Polo, tutte le macchine esenti

en.title: Vehicle tax exemption for cars and motorcycles: from Fiat Panda to Polo, all exempt vehicles
en.summary: The vehicle tax exemption primarily affects small city cars and utility vehicles, including compact SUVs like the Jeep Avenger with traditional engines. Medium and high-end SUVs are excluded from the benefit.

stories.title: Gli hacker chiedono il riscatto a Revolut. Minaccia l’Italia: “Abbiamo documenti della Polizia”.

en.title: Hackers demand ransom from Revolut. Threatens Italy: "We have police documents"
en.summary: A hacker group that breached Revolut claims to have compromised Italian police force systems for six months and possesses 147 gigabytes of data from various Italian police services. The group demanded 3 million euros from the digital bank.

stories.title: Caso Revolut, gli hacker chiedono 3 milioni alla banca: “Abbiamo dati della polizia italiana”

en.title: Revolut Case, hackers demand 3 million from bank: "We have Italian police data"
en.summary: Hackers who claimed responsibility for attacking Revolut are demanding 3 million euros and threatening to publish stolen data, including information on Italian police. Italian authorities have opened investigations and privacy regulators announced immediate inspections of Italian banks.

stories.title: Via il bollo auto per auto piccole e medie e moto. Meloni: "Una delle tasse più odiate"

en.title: Car tax abolished for small and medium cars and motorcycles. Meloni: "One of the most hated taxes"
en.summary: Italy will eliminate the car tax in 2027 for motorcycles and over 70 percent of cars currently in circulation, with each citizen eligible for one exemption.

stories.title: Il governo abolisce il bollo 2027 per le auto piccole e medie. Stop anche per i motocicli

en.title: Government abolishes 2027 car tax for small and medium vehicles. Also ends tax for motorcycles
en.summary: Italy's government will eliminate the vehicle tax starting in 2027 for small and medium-powered cars and all motorcycles, with the measure to be made permanent through budget legislation. Officials described it as removing one of the most unpopular taxes among Italians.

stories.title: Abolito il bollo auto da piccola e media potenza e per tutte le moto. Meloni: “Via una tassa odiosa”

en.title: Car tax abolished for small and medium-powered vehicles and all motorcycles. Meloni: "Removing an odious tax"
en.summary: Italy is eliminating the vehicle tax for motorcycles and cars with engines up to 80 kilowatts, applying to one vehicle per citizen. A fuel discount has also been extended.

stories.title: Caro fertilizzanti, Lollobrigida: via a 136 milioni di aiuti agli agricoltori

en.title: High fertilizer prices, Lollobrigida: 136 million euros in aid for farmers
en.summary: Italy's agriculture ministry has approved an emergency decree allocating 136 million euros to compensate farmers dealing with elevated fertilizer costs.

stories.title: Sulle Linee Vesuviane dieci nuovi treni che assicureranno frequenze di 30 minuti

en.title: Ten new trains on the Vesuvian Lines will ensure 30-minute frequencies
en.summary: Ten new trains have been delivered to the Vesuvian Lines, a railway network operated by Eav and controlled by the Campania Region, with a new timetable established to provide service at 30-minute intervals.

stories.title: Michelin, il sito di Alessandria punta sulla seconda vita degli pneumatici

en.title: Michelin, the Alessandria site focuses on the second life of tyres
en.summary: The Piedmont Michelin facility, marking 55 years of operation, has invested over 400 million in technology and flexibility over five years to focus on tire recycling and reuse.

stories.title: Decathlon in Italia apre al franchising

en.title: Decathlon in Italy opens to franchising
en.summary: Decathlon Italy is shifting its expansion strategy by opening to franchising, with plans to open 91 medium to large-sized stores throughout Italy by 2030.

stories.title: Chiesti i fondi per completare il polo Agroalimentare delle Dop

en.title: Funds requested to complete the Agrifood Hub of Protected Designations of Origin
en.summary: Funding is being sought to complete the redevelopment of La Balzana, Italy's largest property complex seized from organized crime, which will become a regional agrifood park showcasing Campania's typical products.
